description: History-first Amazon repurchases: add-to-cart, cart inspection, and full checkout, but only for items you've bought before. Refuses anything outside your purchase history — that's the safety feature. Multi-account via --profile, dry-run on every mutating command, checkout gated on explicit --yes.
auth_description:
Amazon does not publish a buyer-side API. This CLI imports cookies from
your logged-in browser session (Chrome via kooky, or paste a Cookie header
from DevTools), then talks to the same pages you see on amazon.com.
Cart writes and checkout run through a bundled Playwright helper because
Amazon's checkout endpoints reject static-POST automation.

  amazon-pp-cli profiles add personal --label "Personal account"
  amazon-pp-cli --profile personal auth login

novel_features.name: Repurchase-Only Gate
novel_features.description: Refuses to add anything not matched in the user's purchase history (local SQLite FTS mirror). An agent with this CLI cannot impulse-buy.

novel_features.name: Match Quality Gate
novel_features.description: Reports strict vs loose token matches; loose matches require an explicit --allow-loose after the user confirms the resolved title.

novel_features.name: Reorder Last Order
novel_features.description: Re-adds every line item from the most recent order, with a dry-run preview of the planned items first.

novel_features.name: Confirmation-Gated Checkout
novel_features.description: Places a real order with the account's default address and payment method. Exits 10 without --yes; consent is per-cart-state.

novel_features.name: Manual Handoff Deeplinks
novel_features.description: When Amazon raises a CAPTCHA or sign-in gate, exits 9 with a deeplink so the human finishes the step in their own browser instead of the CLI fighting bot detection.

novel_features.name: Multi-Account Profiles
novel_features.description: Per-profile cookie jars, history databases, and defaults so personal and work Amazon accounts never cross-contaminate.

novel_features.name: History Sync & Search
novel_features.description: Walks /your-orders across recent years into a local SQLite store with FTS5 search, purchase counts, and last-purchased timestamps.
